hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ "$(basename "$f")" = "script.js" ] && node --check "$f" && echo "script.js: syntax OK"; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$(basename "$f")" in Dockerfile|nginx.conf) docker build -t calculator-hook-test . >/tmp/calculator-docker-build.log 2>&1 && echo "Docker build OK" || { echo "Docker build FAILED - see /tmp/calculator-docker-build.log"; tail -20 /tmp/calculator-docker-build.log; } ;; esac; }
